name: mantaprint-hub
changelog: Fix: uploading the HPLIP plugin hung at 'Checking file' forever (hp-plugin's license prompt looped on a closed stdin); hp-plugin now runs under a pseudo-terminal as a background job with a live log.

Drivers & devices is a checklist run in place: every connected device and catalog family gets its ordered steps (support packages, vendor .deb, HP plugin, ScanSnap .nal, HP LaserJet firmware, PPD fallback, verify) with done/todo/blocked state and the action on each open step; HP LaserJet 1000-P1505 firmware can be fetched from the page and is kept across OTA updates.

Drivers & devices: the technical apt package list is replaced by 'Supported printers & scanners' grouped by brand with Printer/Scanner badges, a filter and a search box; 'Install support' fetches the packages a family needs in one go. System packages live under a small 'Hub tools' list.
